issues.issue: Text says patients 'requiring splenomegaly' which misstates the eligibility criterion; the citation says enrollees were 'required to have' splenomegaly and thrombocytopenia, and 'Type 1' is used but the quote only says 'Gaucher disease-related splenomegaly'.
Flagged uncited number '1' is a false positive — it is part of 'Type 1', a disease-type label, not an efficacy/safety number.
Flagged uncited number '31' is a false positive — the citation quote 'Thirty-one patients...were evaluable for efficacy' supports it (written out as a word).

Design text asserts the two doses are '30 Units/kg vs 60 Units/kg every other week'; the randomization dose quote is present but the specific '30 Units/kg or 60 Units/kg' numbers depend on the second citation — acceptable, but the design frames it as a head-to-head comparison when the endpoint quote shows both groups were assessed against baseline, not against each other.

Text states anaphylaxis 'occurred in 9% (3/32) of treatment-naïve patients' which is accurate, but the broader 'Infusion reactions...44%-46%' and the specific per-event percentages (22%/18%, 19%/4%, 19%/11%, 13%/11%) are supported; however the narrative implies infusion reactions and anaphylaxis are distinct categories not clearly stated — minor, otherwise citations cover the numbers.
Field is labeled 'vote' but contains an explanation that no AC was held; cosmetic mislabel, consistent with convened=false.
